integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot frames a lifelike spiritual orator standing behind an ornately carved wooden lectern, wearing a light kufi cap and a flowing traditional robe that drapes naturally over his shoulders. Several microphones on stands are positioned before him on the lectern, and the congregation sits softly out of focus in the background. Golden ambient light washes across his face and the carved details of the lectern. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the orator, with a calm, resonant, measured voice (S1), says: <d>[English] Brothers and sisters, peace be upon you all.</d> [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a closer framing with shallow depth of field, keeping the orator crisp while the blurred congregation remains behind him, a few heads nodding gently. He makes subtle, graceful hand gestures as he speaks — a gentle open palm, then a soft downward motion — his composed, authoritative delivery steady. [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts back to the medium shot as he continues with quiet conviction, saying: <d>[English] Let us walk this path together, with patience and faith.</d> His hand settles calmly on the lectern while the golden light holds steady through the final frame.

overall_soundscape: Soft room ambience with a faint murmur from the out-of-focus congregation, gentle rustle of flowing robe fabric, and the subtle shift of a hand resting on the wooden lectern. A few quiet nods and hushed breathing from the audience fill the background.

non_diegetic_music: Warm, sparse string pads at a slow tempo with a soft sustained swell, gradually fading out near the end.
